name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I'm in the middle of patrolling.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Patrolling? You've been staring outside nonstop this whole time.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You have. You've been pacing back and forth in the exact same spot.」

name: Synn
message: 「What about you two? Are you really free enough to stand around watching me?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin and I were doing a sweets tour, and now we're just strolling around to walk off the food.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Once Nana-chan gets her next break, we're going in for round two.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's one of my few redeeming qualities.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, my break's almost over, so I'm gonna head back to HQ to switch shifts.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Working hard is great and all, Synn, but make sure you actually enjoy yourself too.」
It looks like everyone is enjoying the festivities.

name: Misa
message: 「Stop spacing out and do your patrol properly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is venue security going smoothly on your end?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, of course. In fact, I just caught a suspicious person right now.」
「I merely wished to admire the lovely flowers blooming in full glory across this academy to my heart's content.」
「Indulging in sweet conversation with those maidens is the utmost bliss to me.」
「Oh! Upon closer inspection, you possess a truly splendid visage as well.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Um, I don't really swing that way...」

name: Melphas
message: 「I am Melphas, the noble prince of love and beauty. A pleasure to make your acquaintance.」

name: Melphas
message: 「May I have the honor of learning your name?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, I'm Synn Sakura, the Student Council President.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Oh, the Student Council President! Synn Sakura! What a majestic and dulcet ring that has--how truly marvelous!」

name: Misa
message: 「Alright, that's enough! Let's get you to HQ right now!」

name: Melphas
message: 「Aah! Until we meet again, dear Student Council President... ah.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey! No hitting on people! This way!」
Student Council duties are going pretty smoothly overall.
Macaron, always working so hard all by herself.
Every now and then, having a festival together with everyone isn't so bad, right.

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You guys always pop up out of nowhere.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah, hey! Don't just barge in like that.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I-It's not like that, I just happened to be passing by.」

name: Synn
message: 「Were you on your way to your part-time job?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I don't care about stuff like this at all.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I-I don't even want to l-look at a fun-looking festival like this!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I-It's such a wonderful event that it makes me w-want to throw up!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aaah, wait up, don't leave me behind!」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's see, I'll leave it to you guys to play the part of mascots in costume.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey, I told you not to take charge on your own!」

name: Macaron
message: 「That kind of thing is my job!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Then I'll leave it to you to run the show, Macaron.」

name: Synn
message: 「I want you to see it too, Macaron. It's definitely gonna be fun.」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Geez, I guess I don't have a choice.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm not interested or anything, but if you insist that much, I'll make an exception and tag along for just a little bit.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm gonna see just how good you really are, Big Brother.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, look at this, pretty amazing, right?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Geez! Make sure you come back later, okay?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Said it looked fun, so they're going to go play.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. I hope they enjoy KiraFes.」
A festival that even demons can enjoy. Isn't that wonderful!

name: Macaron
message: 「By the way... what exactly is a festival?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. Everyone gets together, makes a lively ruckus, and eats tons of food?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a little different, but it's just as fun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Didn't they have festivals in the Demon World?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nope. Besides, even parties weren't all that fun.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Mama and Papa would gather a whole bunch of their demon subjects and just brag the whole time.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then that means you were a princess, Macaron!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, yeah. That's all in the past, though.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Now that I've come to the Human World, I'm different. I'm a brand-new me.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm going to become a splendid Demon Lord and bring peace to the Demon World. I'll do what Mama and Papa couldn't.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... You really are amazing, Macaron.」
I wonder if the Demon Lord Macaron is talking about is a little different from the Demon Lords I've heard of...?

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, I still need just a tiny bit more training, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, aren't your mom and dad worried about you?」

name: Misa
message: 「Good grief! Where did that pervert run off to?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, that's the guardian deity of KiraFes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You think so? Still, if you make too much of a fuss, you'll get caught.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aah... this faint blanket-like smell is so manly and nice...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, Sakura-kun!? What on earth is the meaning of this?!」

name: Misa
message: 「Right now, I'm busy chasing after a runaway pervert!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Still, I don't think we should ruin a kid's dream.」

name: Misa
message: 「Heh heh heh... Are you hurt at all, young lady?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey, do you guys know each other?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Blackuma is specially helping us out with KiraFes.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Grrr! It makes me mad, but you've got me beat when it comes to connections, big bro!」

name: Misa
message: 「Heh heh heh... There is no need to worry. I am always on your side.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hyaaaah~! I think I'm gonna get a nosebleed!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm super healthy! Oh, I want your autograph!」

name: Misa
message: 「Heh heh heh... That is already inside your heart.」

name: Misa
message: 「Now then, I have work to attend to, so I must take my leave.」

name: Misa
message: 「Jeez, you're gonna pay for this later!」
Radiating bloodlust as they passed by each other, Blackuma walked away.

name: Macaron
message: 「Aaaah~, I never thought I'd meet someone just like the Great Sage in a place like this.」
So Macaron's actually a fan of Paqy, huh.

name: Macaron
message: 「KiraFes might not be half bad after all!」

name: Synn
message: 「You like that kind of stuff, Macaron?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah, I love it! That mature, rich flavor is just irresistible!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, wanna go check out the bazaar over there?」

name: Synn
message: 「They might have that kind of stuff.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. We got the folks from the shopping district to pitch in, so I'm confident in our selection.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's see... Why don't we take a peek at Tame-san's stall?」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Top-notch, thanks to you. Lookin' for somethin'?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I was wondering if you had any Blackuma plushies or anything.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Plushies, huh? Synn, you really are into that kinda thing...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I've gotten pretty friendly with the people in the shopping district too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't there anything you can do about that?」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Nngh~... If it's a request from Synn and cute little Macaron-chan, I got no choice!」

name: Tame-san
message: 「I only put it out to draw customers and wasn't planning on selling it, but just this once, take it and get outta here!」

name: Tame-san
message: 「It's a Golden Blackuma, otherwise known as a Girackuma keychain!」
According to him, it's apparently quite the collector's item.

name: Tame-san
message: 「Bah, something like this is no big deal.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「In exchange, keep giving Ponpoko your business from here on out.」

name: Macaron
message: 「That just shows how much Big Brother is trusted by everyone in the shopping district...」

name: Synn
message: 「Then let's go get something to eat at Prier.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, I guess I have no choice! For my starving big brother's sake, I'll tag along!」

name: Tame-san
message: 「...Since when did Synn get a little sister?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Welcome to the Wagashi Club's tearoom, we are delighted to have you.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, big brother basically dragged me here!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Rii-a, might I ask who this young lady is?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, um, her name is Macaron-chan, and she's... sort of like Synn-kun's little sister, I guess?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, it seems you have complicated circumstances, so I won't pry too deeply.」

name: Ria
message: 「Let's see~. How about some nice, warm oshiruko? You've been outside this whole time, so you must be cold, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「I'll throw in a little extra on the house.\s07」

name: Ria
message: 「See, that's just what I told you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Gulp... Ah, excuse me. I was saying it's delicious.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I already know that much. Not you--I mean Miss Macaron.」

name: Ria
message: 「Are you not good with sweet things?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine. It's delicious, and it'll warm you right up.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Here you are, some tea I've let cool down.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh dear, has it still not cooled down enough for you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron, hang in there. Here, have some milk.」

name: Ria
message: 「Macaron-chan... could it be you're sensitive to hot foods?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「And a rather severe case of it, it would seem.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ugh~, this is the one thing I just haven't been able to help since I was little.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see--if you can't handle hot food, there's no helping it.」

name: Ria
message: 「In that case, I'll get you a different Japanese sweet.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Since we've caused you such trouble, please don't worry about the bill.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, thank you very much, sorry about that.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「We are deeply indebted to the President, after all.」

name: Macaron
message: 「No wonder they call them the Student Council President...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Here you are, thank you kindly for waiting.」

name: Synn
message: 「The oshiruko really was a disaster, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「Who knew you had a sensitive tongue, Macaron.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I mean, it's not like you can train yourself to get over that.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then big brother, can you endure this?」
Macaron's hands dart swiftly toward my sides.

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihihi, see? Even you have things you just can't help, big brother.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Having a sensitive tongue is the exact same thing.」
Things like the Demon Lord really are beyond what I can handle on my own, huh.

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. It's quiet around here, so let's take a little break.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's a church. It's a place where people pray to God.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Because even if you do that, nobody's gonna come save you.」

name: Macaron
message: 「When you're in trouble, you have to figure things out with your own strength.」

name: Macaron
message: 「If there's anyone you can rely on, it'd only be a magnificent Demon Lord like you, Master.」
I wonder if I have to become someone who's thought of like that, too.

name: Synn
message: 「So, um, is your master really that amazing, Macaron?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Of course! Some shady guy like God doesn't even hold a candle to him!」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you saying you do not believe in the Lord?」

name: Azel
message: 「A Demon Lord is nothing more than the ramblings of fools.」

name: Azel
message: 「The will of the Lord alone is the truth that governs this world.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Clinging to an illusion like God makes you way more of a weirdo!」

name: Azel
message: 「I was guided by the Lord's voice. The Lord's existence is unshakable.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well then, I've met the Demon Lord before, and I'm gonna be the next Demon Lord!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh my, if it isn't the President and his little sister.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. I was thinking of looking around KiraFes with Azel-san during our break, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. KiraFes is fun, you know.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh? Oh, yeah. I guess it's okay.」

name: Macaron
message: 「What did you say?! That's not true!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Everyone's working really hard to make this a fun festival!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Wah, I mean, y-you'd say the exact same thing anyway, Big Brother!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel? She's a little eccentric, sure, but I don't think she's a bad kid.」

name: Synn
message: 「So I figured if she had fun with everyone, maybe she'd crack a smile, even just a little.」

name: Macaron
message: 「You have so many friends because you really care about everyone.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't actually know how Azel felt about it, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, when all's said and done, she did show up again today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hehehe, isn't it fine if I tease you every once in a while, Macaron?」

name: Macaron
message: 「No, it's not! Big Brother is supposed to stay wrapped around my little finger!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I really think Azel-san came by today because you're here, Big Brother.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I think everyone else gathered here because of you too, Big Brother.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, we were the ones who asked them for help, after all.」

name: Macaron
message: 「You draw people in, Big Brother. You have that kind of power!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Because you work so earnestly for everyone's sake, everyone lent you their strength...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Watching today's KiraFes made me think that must be why.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, I don't think it's anything as grand as that, though.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez, you're such an idiot, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「The rival I need to surpass most right now is you, Big Brother.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yep. You have the qualities needed to be a Demon Lord, Big Brother.」

name: Macaron
message: 「So if I'm losing to the likes of you, I'll never become a great Demon Lord.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Anyway! I'm definitely going to surpass you, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Honestly, I think beating you up would be the quickest way, though.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihihi, I'm just kidding. I wouldn't play dirty like that!」
Potential as a Demon Lord... Is that really something I should be happy about?

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah! Jeez, where have you all been this whole time?」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Even though we were finally having fun.」

name: Macaron
message: 「You see... these little ones just wanted someone to play with them.」

name: Macaron
message: 「And yet, they got yelled at and chased away...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Even though they didn't mean to do anything bad, they weren't allowed to join in.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I know. Nobody's saying it's your fault, Big Brother.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Meeting you made me feel like even humans and Demons could become friends, Big Brother.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Since they were people who gathered because they trusted you, Big Brother... I thought it would be okay, and yet...」

name: Macaron
message: 「In the end, we really can't get along, can we...」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's talk this through properly. If we do, I'm sure!」

name: Macaron
message: 「...They've already been hurt once. That won't change.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I don't want them to go through anything like that ever again...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll explain everything properly to everyone too, so...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Without a Demon Lord, everyone really can't get along after all!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Don't get in the way of me becoming the Demon Lord...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, Sakura-kun, what are you slacking off in a place like this for!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Things were completely hectic back there without you, Synn!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A demon appeared at the KiraFes venue, you know!」

name: Ria
message: 「We were chasing after that demon, and...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Geez, what's the big idea disappearing right when it matters most.」

name: Misa
message: 「And when we still have KiraFes to run, too, honestly...」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, everyone! Let's let her go this time!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well... I think there are things we can resolve by talking, without fighting.」

name: Ria
message: 「I understand how you feel, Synn-kun, but...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I have no intention of doing that!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm not going to get along with you guys!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Because I don't want to be betrayed anymore...」

name: Macaron
message: 「So that you can never get in my way again... I'll beat you all down!」

name: Misa
message: 「Looks like they're ready for a fight, though...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When someone picks a fight, we've gotta take 'em up on it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I would prefer to handle this peacefully, but as things stand, they do not seem willing to even listen to us.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. Even if you want to persuade Macaron-chan, at this rate...」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if I have to use force, I want to talk to Macaron.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't really get what's going on, but... if you say so, Synn, leave it to me!」

name: Misa
message: 「You're going to explain this whole thing to me properly later.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So it is a battle for the sake of peace!」

name: Macaron
message: 「This time for sure, I'm gonna make it so you can't lay a finger on the Demon!」
